capabilities: Split folders and files into separate panels
Toggle between horizontal and vertical split layouts
Customize sorting order of files and folders
Pin frequently used files or folders to the top
Adapt styling to the current Obsidian theme
extras: README lists planned features not yet implemented: customizable default locations, mobile support, and tag-based management.
motivation: The author wanted a cleaner, more intuitive way to browse and organize notes, inspired by Apple's design principles.
problem: Obsidian's default file explorer mixes folders and files in a single list, which makes it harder to keep track of your location while browsing.
summary: File explorer plugin that splits the folder and file lists into two separate, visually distinct panels with sorting and pinning.
